## Math

Inline: $\mathbf{x} \in \mathbb{R}^{d}$ and $p(y \mid x)$.

Numbered equation:

$$
\mathcal{L}(\theta) = -\sum_{i=1}^{N} \log p_\theta(y_i \mid x_i)
$$ {#eq-loss}

See @eq-loss.

Aligned equations:

$$
\begin{aligned}
Q &= X W_Q \\
K &= X W_K \\
V &= X W_V
\end{aligned}
$$

## Executed code

```{python}
import numpy as np
print(np.round(np.random.default_rng(0).normal(size=(2, 3)), 3))
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-sine
#| fig-cap: "A sine wave."
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200)
plt.plot(t, np.sin(t))
plt.show()
```
